about_short_description.short_description: Bot MD is an artificial intelligence clinical assistant for doctors.

product.name: Bot MD Care
product.description: An AI-powered platform that automates patient engagement, monitoring, education, and follow-up via popular chat apps without requiring patients to download an app.

product.name: Bot MD Chatbot
product.description: An AI chatbot tailored for healthcare that handles patient inquiries, FAQs, appointment scheduling, and follow-ups across multiple chat apps and languages with no hallucinations.

product.name: Bot MD Hospital
product.description: A clinical assistant super app that integrates hospital information systems to provide instant access to rosters, guidelines, protocols, alerts, and clinical tools via a single chat interface.
